text:
Nina CSM: FYI 10am PT next Thursday is the Northbridge EBR. Need a tight 1-slide "playbook" and a live action ticker for post-meeting ops. Slides are at ~draft.
Jordan SE: I can run the live demo. Suggest 1 canonical demo + 1 micro-fallback. Keep each demo under 4m.
Priya AM: We should include a 30s renewal signal slide. Health dropped 7% last week after onboarding lag. Can someone surface the underlying tickets?
Liam Enablement: I'll own the action tracker and capture enablement asks. Planning a 25-min rehearsal Wed morning. Will assign owners in the sheet.
deckbot: Uploaded new version: https://drive.redwood.com/nb-ebr/draft_v0.4  comments on slide 2.
Nina CSM: Jordan, add a single line in the slide notes: "Fallback: use quantized model if 95th latency > 300ms". Priya, include a 2-line exec blurb for the renewal slide.
Jordan SE: ack. Will add step-by-step run notes and an offline demo gif in case streaming fails.
Priya AM: Quick risk breakdown: (a) onboarding backlog, (b) missing SLA on ingest, (c) invoicing dispute. I'll draft a succinct summary + suggested mitigations.
Liam Enablement: Action ticker template: `Owner | Task | ETA | Priority | Status | Follow-up owner`. I'll make it editable for owners and view-only for execs.
Nina CSM: Good. Also add a "confidence" column (Low/Med/High) for each mitigation.
Jordan SE: Engineering ask  can eng-runtime provide two bullets on recent perf variance for the slide? I'll @eng-runtime on the rehearsal invite.
Liam Enablement: I'll consolidate bullets into a single slide: "Enablement asks & success criteria". Adding owners now.
Nina CSM: Final timeline: (1) slides updated by Wed 9am PT, (2) rehearsal Wed 10:30am PT, (3) action ticker live in deck, (4) exec intro: 45s health + 90s roadmap highlight. Call out conflicts now.
Priya AM: I have a calendar conflict at 10:30am but can join the second half. Will drop a 90s voice note with my exec blurb if needed.
Jordan SE: Ill bring the laptop and local assets. Also prepping a 60s fallback demo that can run offline.
Liam Enablement: Live ticker link: https://sheets.redwood.com/nb-ebr-actions  populating rows and pinging owners.
Nina CSM: Thanks all. After rehearsal we'll triage follow-ups by priority and set SLAs for each action. :thumbsup:
Priya AM: Perfect, thanks everyone.
Jordan SE: See you at rehearsal.
Liam Enablement: Will drop the sheet link in the deck comments and send owner pings now.
